The structure of Dy6Fe2 (reduced formula Dy3Fe) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Dy centers with 12 geometric neighbors (6 Dy, 6 Fe) in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Fe centers have 10 Dy neighbors; both environments form a single three-dimensional connected component. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between Dy 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Dy and Fe polyhedra.
